official.q: Is this an official government or utility app?
official.a: No. This is an independent, community-run tracker, not affiliated with DPDC, DESCO, BPDB, NESCO, WZPDCL, Palli Bidyut, or any government body. Every report comes from a regular person, not an official source.

prediction.q: How does the "when outages happen" chart predict load-shedding?
prediction.a: It isn't a real forecast — it's a rough pattern built from when past reports were submitted, showing which hours tend to have more reports. Think of it as an educated guess based on community history, not a guarantee of what will happen next.

reportHow.q: How do I report an outage in my area?
reportHow.a: Tap "Report outage", pick your division, district and area, and enter when it started. It shows up on the live board right away for your neighbors to see.

resolveHow.q: How do I mark my area as having power again?
resolveHow.a: Open "My reports" in the header and tap "Power's back" on your ongoing report — no need to file a new one.

privacy.q: Is my location or personal data tracked?
privacy.a: No accounts and no personal data are collected. The only location info stored is the division/district/area you choose when reporting. Which reports you've confirmed is remembered only in your own browser, not on a server.
